## Learning goals

- fit mean / naïve / seasonal naïve / drift;
- visually compare forecasts.

```{r}
library(fpp3)
train <- aus_production |> filter_index(. ~ "2005 Q4")
```

## 1. Fit benchmarks

```{r}
fit <- train |>
  model(
    Mean = MEAN(Beer),
    Naive = NAIVE(Beer),
    SNaive = SNAIVE(Beer),
    Drift = RW(Beer ~ drift())
  )
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = "8 quarters")
fc |> autoplot(aus_production)
```

## DELIVERABLE

Which method looks most reasonable for Beer? Why (1–2 sentences)?
